fields.title: Doboku Kōgaku oyobi Kenchiku Anzen Kensa Hōkoku

investigation.location: Liem Sioe Lan shi no Tenpo, Balikpapan

case.subject: Haisui fuguai oyobi tenpo kiso shinshoku no gijutsu chōsa
case.incident: Kōkyō kōji no ryūshutsu sui ga tenpo no kōzō hogo kōzō o sonshō shita

findings: Kōan to doboku chōsa ni yori, kōkyō kōji ni yoru haisui shisetsu no fuguai ga kōzōteki sonshō o hikiokoshita koto ga kakunin sareta.
Kiso bu wa kōji chiiki kara no ryūshutsu de hageshiku shinshoku sarete iru.
fields.conclusion: Gijutsuteki shōko ni yori kōkyō kōji no kashitsu ga risshō sareta tame, shinseisha no seikyū wa datō de aru.
recommendations: Sumiyaka ni kiso no shūzen to kōkyō haisui no saisekkei o jisshi suru koto.

claims.fact: Chōsa hōkoku wa, kōkyō haisui no fuguai ga kiso sonshō no gen'in dearu koto o gijutsuteki ni kakunin shite iru.
